blocks.en:
### Start from local PDB and SDF files Open PowerShell in a new project directory and set the absolute paths to the source PDB and SDF files. The example stages the two selected files under the tutorial's standard names. Use PowerShell for staging and WSL or Linux for Bash instructions. On Linux, copy the selected files directly to `input/` under the same names. [Microsoft WSL filesystem guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/filesystems)
PowerShell staging example **Environment:** `PowerShell`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
### 从现有文件开始 在新的项目工作目录中打开 PowerShell，分别填写原始 PDB 和 SDF 的绝对路径。下例只复制指定文件，副本使用本教程的统一文件名。PowerShell 用于导入，后续标为 Bash 的命令在 WSL 或 Linux 中执行。已在 Linux 中工作时，直接把指定文件复制到项目的 `input/`，使用相同文件名。 [Microsoft WSL filesystem guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/filesystems)
PowerShell 导入示例 **环境：** `PowerShell`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```powershell
$Protein = 'C:\path\to\protein.pdb'
$Ligand  = 'C:\path\to\ligand.sdf'

if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $Protein -PathType Leaf) -or
    !(Test-Path -LiteralPath $Ligand -PathType Leaf)) {
    throw 'Check the two input file paths.'
}

$InputDir = Join-Path (Get-Location).Path 'input'
$ProteinCopy = Join-Path $InputDir 'protein_raw.pdb'
$LigandCopy = Join-Path $InputDir 'ligand_raw.sdf'
if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $ProteinCopy) -or (Test-Path -LiteralPath $LigandCopy)) {
    throw 'The input directory already has a staged file. Use a fresh project directory.'
}

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $InputDir -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $Protein -Destination $ProteinCopy -ErrorAction Stop
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $Ligand -Destination $LigandCopy -ErrorAction Stop
wsl pwd
```

blocks.en:
Use `wsl pwd` to identify the WSL path corresponding to the current directory and verify the two copies there. Recheck paths if you move the project to the Linux filesystem.

</details>

| Source input | Requirements for the next step |
| --- | --- |
| `input/protein_raw.pdb` | Review assembly, chains, pocket, nonstandard components, and missing regions. Prepare `protein.pdb` for MD and `receptorH.pdb` for docking. |
| `input/ligand_raw.sdf` (2D SDF) | Verify bond orders, stereochemistry, and microstate, then generate a 3D conformer with explicit hydrogens for Meeko. |
| `input/ligand_raw.sdf` (3D SDF) | Review coordinates, explicit hydrogens, chemistry, and record number. A validated single record can be used directly for ligand preparation. |

[Ligand input requirements](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/lig_prep_basic.html) · [Complex structure review](TROUBLESHOOTING.md#complex-systems)

| Input | Preparation |
| --- | --- |
| `input/protein.pdb` | Prepare the protein for MD. Review the biological assembly, chains, alternate conformations, missing residues and heavy atoms, disulfides, termini, and histidine states. Retain the original structure, PDB ID and curation rationale. |
| `input/receptorH.pdb` | Provide a Meeko-compatible receptor in the same coordinate frame using reviewed protonation assumptions. Evaluate each water, ion, or cofactor for its role in the pocket. |
| `input/ligand_raw.sdf` | Obtain a molecule record with defined bond orders, stereochemistry, and identity. Record the CID or other source, pH assumption, and integer net charge of each candidate. |
| `dock/box.txt` | Define and visually check the search box using the co-crystal ligand or other pocket evidence. Use Å for the center coordinates and all three edge lengths. Keep a separate configuration for each receptor or pocket. |

Structure databases and setup docs · [RCSB PDB](https://www.rcsb.org/) · [PubChem](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/) · [Meeko receptor options](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/rec_cli_options.html) · [Molscrub CLI](https://molscrub.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cli.html)

**Receptor files for docking and MD.** Review chain identity, alternate locations, missing atoms or residues, and any essential solvent molecules or cofactors in the source structure. Open-source PyMOL can be used to curate `input/protein.pdb`. Review the hydrogen and protonation model in `input/receptorH.pdb` before generating receptor PDBQT with Meeko. AutoDockTools can assist with legacy preparation and AutoGrid parameter files (GPF). Use the prepared protein PDB for MD topology generation with `pdb2gmx`. [Meeko receptor preparation](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/rec_cli_options.html) · [Scripps AutoDock Suite](https://ccsb.scripps.edu/autodocksuite/)

The example selects record 1 from the Molscrub output. Substitute the record number established during chemical review. You may supply a vetted single-record 3D SDF with explicit hydrogens as `ligands/state001.sdf`. Assign a distinct identifier to each ligand microstate.

**Environment:** `docktools`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
`wsl pwd` 用来确认 WSL 中当前目录对应的路径。在该目录核对两个副本。若后续将项目移到 Linux 文件系统，重新核对工作目录和输入路径。

</details>

| 原始输入 | 进入下一步的条件 |
| --- | --- |
| `input/protein_raw.pdb` | 核对组装、链、口袋、非标准成分及缺失区域。之后分别准备 MD 用的 `protein.pdb` 和对接用的 `receptorH.pdb`。 |
| `input/ligand_raw.sdf`，2D | 先确定 bond order（键级）、手性和微观状态，再生成 3D 构象及显式氢，供 Meeko 制备。 |
| `input/ligand_raw.sdf`，3D | 审核坐标、显式氢、化学状态和记录号。合格的单条记录可直接用于配体制备。 |

[Ligand input requirements](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/lig_prep_basic.html) · [复杂结构审核](TROUBLESHOOTING.zh-CN.md#complex-systems)

| 输入 | 准备要求 |
| --- | --- |
| `input/protein.pdb` | 准备供 MD 使用的蛋白，确认生物学装配、链、替代构象、缺失残基和 heavy atom（重原子）、二硫键、端基以及 His 状态。保留原始结构、PDB ID 和取舍依据。 |
| `input/receptorH.pdb` | 使用同一 receptor（受体）坐标系和已审查的质子化假设，提供适合 Meeko 的 receptor（受体）。逐个审查水、离子和辅因子对口袋的作用。 |
| `input/ligand_raw.sdf` | 获取有明确 bond order（键级）、手性和身份的小分子记录。记录 CID 或其他来源、pH 假设和每个候选的整数净电荷。 |
| `dock/box.txt` | 根据共晶配体或其他口袋证据确定搜索盒，目视确认它覆盖预期区域。中心和三个边长均以 Å 计。每个 receptor（受体）或不同口袋应保留自己的配置。 |

来源与命令参考 · [RCSB PDB](https://www.rcsb.org/) · [PubChem](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/) · [Meeko receptor options](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/rec_cli_options.html) · [Molscrub CLI](https://molscrub.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cli.html)

**receptor（受体）分两份处理** 从同一份源结构确定链、altloc、缺失部分、口袋水和所需辅助成分。可用开源 PyMOL 查看和选择链，保存经审核的 `input/protein.pdb`。为 `input/receptorH.pdb` 确定氢与 protonation state（质子化状态）后，用 Meeko 制备 receptor（受体） PDBQT。已有 AutoDockTools 的读者可用它辅助加氢、查看旧 GPF 或准备对接 receptor（受体），但应逐项复核化学状态和盒范围。MD 仍从经审核的蛋白 PDB 用 `pdb2gmx` 生成 topology（拓扑）。 [Meeko receptor preparation](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/rec_cli_options.html) · [Scripps AutoDock Suite](https://ccsb.scripps.edu/autodocksuite/)

下例从 Molscrub 输出中选第 1 条作为候选。按实际审核结果替换记录号。若已有确认过的带显式氢、单记录 3D SDF，可直接将其保存为 `ligands/state001.sdf`。为不同化学状态使用独立 ID。

**环境：** `docktools`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
conda activate docktools
scrub.py input/ligand_raw.sdf -o ligands/candidates.sdf --ph 7.4
obabel ligands/candidates.sdf -ocan
obabel ligands/candidates.sdf -f 1 -l 1 -O ligands/state001.sdf
```

blocks.en:
**Review the candidate with RDKit.** From the `docktools` environment, load the selected SDF in Python and verify stereochemistry, integer net charge, explicit hydrogen count, and the 3D conformer flag. Resolve any parsing or chemical-identity discrepancy before calling Meeko. [RDKit Python guide](https://www.rdkit.org/docs/GettingStartedInPython.html)

**Environment:** `docktools`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
**用 RDKit 检查候选** 命令块在已激活的 `docktools` 中执行。进入 Python 后读入所选 SDF，核对手性、整数净电荷、显式氢和 3D 标记。若读取失败或结构与预期不符，回到候选选择。退出 Python 后再调用 Meeko。 [RDKit Python guide](https://www.rdkit.org/docs/GettingStartedInPython.html)

**环境：** `docktools`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
python
```

```python
from rdkit import Chem

candidate = Chem.SDMolSupplier("ligands/state001.sdf", removeHs=False)[0]
Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(candidate), isomericSmiles=True)
Chem.GetFormalCharge(candidate)
sum(atom.GetAtomicNum() == 1 for atom in candidate.GetAtoms())
candidate.GetConformer().Is3D()
exit()
```

blocks.en: **Environment:** `Bash`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.

```bash
mk_prepare_receptor.py --read_pdb input/receptorH.pdb -o dock/receptor -p

sha256sum input/* > qc/input_sha256.txt
```

blocks.en:
Write the six fields to `dock/box.txt` and substitute the actual center and edge lengths. Convert legacy AutoGrid interval counts to Å using the grid spacing. If the binding site is unknown, use a separate exploratory box and evaluate sampling and pocket plausibility.

The numbers below are the public 1IEP box in Å. For a different receptor, review and replace all six values.
blocks.zh:
将下列六项保存为 `dock/box.txt`，把示例值替换为自己测定的中心与尺寸。旧 AutoGrid 参数中的网格间隔数乘间距才得到 Å。对于无已知口袋的结构，可另建探索性搜索盒并检查采样收敛和口袋证据。

下面是公开 1IEP 搜索盒的数值，单位 Å。使用其他受体时，应核对并替换全部六个值。

blocks.shared:

```ini
center_x = 15.190
center_y = 53.903
center_z = 16.917
size_x = 20.0
size_y = 20.0
size_z = 20.0
```

blocks.en: **Check.** Verify the SDF record count, explicit hydrogens, stereochemistry, bond orders, and net charge. Check that the ligand PDBQT retains the Meeko mapping metadata and that the receptor, reference ligand, and search box use the same coordinate frame. [Meeko documentation](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/) · [Open Babel CLI](https://openbabel.org/docs/Command-line_tools/babel.html) **Structure and chemistry references.** Use wwPDB validation reports to review deposited experimental structures and the Chemical Component Dictionary to check ligand identifiers. [wwPDB validation reports](https://www.wwpdb.org/validation/validation-reports) · [Chemical Component Dictionary](https://www.wwpdb.org/data/ccd) **Focused screening, blind docking, and follow-up.** Use a focused box when structural evidence identifies the binding site. Validate the protocol by redocking when a co-crystal pose is available. For exploratory docking, use a separate file such as `dock/box_blind.txt` and record the coverage, seeds, and search settings. Inspect pose clusters for structurally plausible pockets, then use separate focused boxes and output directories for follow-up. In a legacy GPF, `npts 60 60 60` with `spacing 0.375` defines three 22.5 Å edges. Resolve `gridcenter auto` to verified coordinates before writing the Vina configuration. [Vina FAQ](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/faq.html) ## 04. Batch docking on CPU and GPU - **Input** PDBQT, box and manifest - **Outputs** scored poses and job logs - **If a step fails** inspect failed entries before resuming Use the receptor PDBQT, ligand PDBQT files, and search box from step 03 with the selected engine. Use a separate output directory for each screen. Prepare ligands individually or pass a reviewed multi-record SDF to Meeko with `--multimol_outdir`. Track the mapping between ligand IDs and source SDF records, including duplicate IDs and failed preparations.[7](REFERENCES.md#ref-7) [Meeko ligand CLI](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/lig_cli_options.html) ### A. CPU · AutoDock Vina Run a single curated ligand and inspect its output and log before launching the batch. **Environment:** `docktools`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart. If Vina exits with an error, inspect the log and use a new output directory for a retry.
blocks.zh: **验收** 核对 SDF 记录、显式氢、手性、bond order（键级）和净电荷。配体 PDBQT 应保留 Meeko 写入的化学映射信息。receptor（受体）文件、参考配体和搜索盒应在同一坐标系中。 [Meeko documentation](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/) · [Open Babel CLI](https://openbabel.org/docs/Command-line_tools/babel.html) **结构与化学核对** 实验结构使用 wwPDB 验证报告复核质量，配体标识可用化学组分字典核对。 [wwPDB validation reports](https://www.wwpdb.org/validation/validation-reports) · [Chemical Component Dictionary](https://www.wwpdb.org/data/ccd) **局部筛选、盲对接和复筛** 有共晶或可靠位点时，优先用局部盒并用重对接验收。无已知口袋时，用单独的探索性盒（如 `dock/box_blind.txt`）记录范围、种子和搜索力度，检查候选是否集中在有结构依据的口袋，再为候选口袋新建局部盒和输出目录进行复筛。保留不同盒的独立结果。旧 GPF 可用 `grep -E '^(npts|spacing|gridcenter)[[:space:]]' receptor.gpf` 查字段。例如 `npts 60 60 60` 和 `spacing 0.375` 对应三边各 22.5 Å。若 `gridcenter` 为 `auto`，应重新核实真实中心再填写。 [Vina FAQ](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/faq.html) ## 04. CPU 与 GPU 批量对接 - **输入** PDBQT、对接盒和清单 - **输出** 输出已打分的 docking pose（对接位姿）和日志 - **失败时的操作** 续跑前检查失败条目 各引擎使用步骤 03 的 receptor（受体）PDBQT、配体 PDBQT 和搜索盒。为每个筛选条件保留独立目录。可逐个调用 Meeko 生成配体 PDBQT，或用 `--multimol_outdir` 处理已审核的多记录 SDF。保留候选 ID 与原始 SDF 的对应表，并检查重名和漏项。[7](REFERENCES.zh-CN.md#ref-7) [Meeko ligand CLI](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/lig_cli_options.html) ### A. CPU · AutoDock Vina 先跑一个已审核配体，核对日志和 docking pose（对接位姿）后再开始批量筛选。 **环境：** `docktools`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。 若 Vina 返回错误，先查看日志，再用新的输出目录重试。

blocks.shared:
```bash
conda activate docktools &&
mkdir dock/cpu_single_202601 &&
  vina --receptor dock/receptor.pdbqt --ligand ligands/pdbqt/state001.pdbqt  --config dock/box.txt --scoring vina --cpu 4 --exhaustiveness 32  --num_modes 20 --seed 202601 --out dock/cpu_single_202601/state001_out.pdbqt  > dock/cpu_single_202601/vina.log 2>&1 &&
  tail -20 dock/cpu_single_202601/vina.log &&
  grep -E '^MODEL|^REMARK VINA RESULT' dock/cpu_single_202601/state001_out.pdbqt
```

blocks.en: **Environment:** `docktools`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh: **环境：** `docktools`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
mkdir dock/cpu_batch_202601 &&
  time vina --receptor dock/receptor.pdbqt --batch ligands/pdbqt/*.pdbqt  --config dock/box.txt --scoring vina --cpu 4 --exhaustiveness 32  --num_modes 20 --seed 202601 --dir dock/cpu_batch_202601  > dock/cpu_batch_202601/vina.log 2>&1 &&
  find ligands/pdbqt -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.pdbqt' | wc -l &&
  find dock/cpu_batch_202601 -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.pdbqt' | wc -l
```

blocks.en:
`--batch` processes ligands sequentially against one receptor. `--cpu 4` sets the thread count for a Vina process. Split large libraries into separate jobs to parallelize within your CPU allocation. Use a separately defined box for each receptor. [Vina native batch mode](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docking_in_batch.html)

#### Native Windows Vina and WSL2 handoff

For WSL preparation followed by native Windows Vina, copy the docking files to your Windows profile. Replace `YOUR_WINDOWS_USER` and run these commands from the WSL project root. Keep the original SDF and the MD-ready protein PDB in the WSL project. Use the Windows drive for the handoff. [Microsoft WSL filesystems](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/wsl/filesystems)

**Environment:** `Bash`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
`--batch` 针对同一 receptor（受体）逐个处理配体，`--cpu 4` 控制一次 Vina 进程的线程数。拆分大库后可在 CPU 配额内并行运行多个独立批次。多个 receptor（受体）分别使用各自的搜索盒。 [Vina native batch mode](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docking_in_batch.html)

#### Windows 原生 Vina 与 WSL2 文件交接

如果使用 WSL Bash 做准备、原生 Windows 运行 Vina，先把必要的对接文件复制到 Windows 用户目录。替换 `YOUR_WINDOWS_USER`，在 WSL 项目根目录执行。原始 SDF 和 receptor（受体）供 MD 使用的 PDB 留在 WSL 项目中。Windows 盘在这里只用于交接。 [Microsoft WSL filesystems](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/wsl/filesystems)

**环境：** `Bash`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
win_user='YOUR_WINDOWS_USER'
win_job="/mnt/c/Users/$win_user/MD_exchange/target01"
mkdir -p "/mnt/c/Users/$win_user/MD_exchange"
mkdir "$win_job" &&
  mkdir -p "$win_job/dock" "$win_job/ligands/pdbqt" &&
  cp dock/receptor.pdbqt dock/box.txt "$win_job/dock/" &&
  cp ligands/pdbqt/*.pdbqt "$win_job/ligands/pdbqt/"
```

blocks.en:
Enter the exchange directory in Windows PowerShell. The example expects the upstream executable there as `vina.exe`. Set `$Vina` to its full path if it is installed elsewhere. Run the following block in the same PowerShell session used for this Windows batch. [Official Windows batch instructions](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docking_in_batch.html)

**Environment:** `PowerShell`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
在 Windows PowerShell 进入交接目录。示例假定官方可执行文件放在该目录并命名为 `vina.exe`。如已安装在其他位置，将 `$Vina` 改为完整路径。以下代码在执行这次 Windows 批处理的同一个 PowerShell 会话中运行。 [Official Windows batch instructions](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docking_in_batch.html)

**环境：** `PowerShell`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```powershell
Set-Location -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'MD_exchange\target01') -ErrorAction Stop
$Vina = '.\vina.exe'
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $Vina -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Set $Vina to the Vina executable path.' }
& $Vina --version
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Vina version check failed.' }
$Ligands = @(Get-ChildItem '.\ligands\pdbqt' -Filter '*.pdbqt' -File |
    Sort-Object Name | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName)
if ($Ligands.Count -eq 0) { throw 'No ligand PDBQT files found' }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path '.\dock\cpu_batch_win_202601' -ErrorAction Stop
& $Vina --receptor .\dock\receptor.pdbqt --batch $Ligands --config .\dock\box.txt `
    --scoring vina --cpu 4 --exhaustiveness 32 --num_modes 20 --seed 202601 `
    --dir .\dock\cpu_batch_win_202601 > .\dock\cpu_batch_win_202601\vina.log 2>&1
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'See the Vina log' }
(Get-ChildItem '.\dock\cpu_batch_win_202601' -Filter '*.pdbqt' -File).Count
```

blocks.en:
Return to the same WSL Bash session and project root. Copy the entire batch output and inspect the log and poses. In a new terminal, set `win_job` again first. In step 05, set `pose_file` to the candidate file you copied back. Run subsequent setup and trajectory work on the WSL filesystem.

**Environment:** `Bash`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
回到同一 WSL 项目根目录和 Bash 会话，复制这一批的完整输出，检查日志与候选姿态。若打开了新终端，先重新设定 `win_job`。在步骤 05 将 `pose_file` 设为实际复制回来的候选 PDBQT 路径；后续建系与轨迹都在 WSL 文件系统内运行。

**环境：** `Bash`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
test -d "$win_job/dock/cpu_batch_win_202601" &&
  test ! -e dock/cpu_batch_win_202601 &&
  cp -a "$win_job/dock/cpu_batch_win_202601" dock/
find dock/cpu_batch_win_202601 -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.pdbqt' -print
tail -20 dock/cpu_batch_win_202601/vina.log
```

blocks.en:
### B. NVIDIA GPU · Uni-Dock CUDA

Run from the Linux or WSL2 project root. Verify a single ligand with `--gpu_batch` first. During a longer run, monitor GPU activity with `nvidia-smi -l 1` in a second terminal. [Uni-Dock CLI](https://github.com/dptech-corp/Uni-Dock/tree/main/unidock)

**Environment:** `dockgpu`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
### B. NVIDIA GPU · Uni-Dock CUDA

在 Linux 或 WSL2 的项目根目录执行。首次用 `--gpu_batch` 测一个配体。独立终端运行 `nvidia-smi -l 1` 可观察稍长测试的 GPU 使用情况。 [Uni-Dock CLI](https://github.com/dptech-corp/Uni-Dock/tree/main/unidock)

**环境：** `dockgpu`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
conda activate dockgpu && (
  set -euo pipefail
  job=dock/gpu_single_202601
  mkdir "$job"
  unidock --receptor dock/receptor.pdbqt --gpu_batch ligands/pdbqt/state001.pdbqt \
    --config dock/box.txt --scoring vina --search_mode balance --num_modes 20 \
    --seed 202601 --dir "$job" > "$job/unidock.log" 2>&1
  tail -25 "$job/unidock.log"
  find "$job" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.pdbqt' -print

```

blocks.en:
Pass a manifest to `--ligand_index` with one relative path per line and unique filenames without spaces. Measure device memory use, throughput, and output completeness on a representative subset before scaling.

**Environment:** `Bash`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
批量任务用 `--ligand_index` 读取清单。每行一个相对路径，使用无空格且唯一的文件名。先用小批代表性输入测量显存占用、耗时和输出完整性，再调整批次大小。

**环境：** `Bash`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
(
  set -euo pipefail
  mkdir dock/gpu_batch_202601
  find ligands/pdbqt -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.pdbqt' | LC_ALL=C sort > dock/gpu_batch_202601/ligands.txt
  test -s dock/gpu_batch_202601/ligands.txt
)
```

blocks.en:
Run after confirming the manifest is nonempty. If VRAM is limited, split it with `split -l 32 dock/gpu_batch_202601/ligands.txt dock/gpu_chunk_`. Give every run its own manifest path, log, and output directory.

**Environment:** `dockgpu`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
确认清单非空后运行。显存不足时用 `split -l 32 dock/gpu_batch_202601/ligands.txt dock/gpu_chunk_` 拆分清单。每次更换清单路径、日志和输出目录。

**环境：** `dockgpu`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
(
  set -euo pipefail
  set -o noclobber
  job=dock/gpu_batch_202601
  test -s "$job/ligands.txt"
  time unidock --receptor dock/receptor.pdbqt --ligand_index "$job/ligands.txt" \
    --config dock/box.txt --scoring vina --search_mode balance --num_modes 20 \
    --seed 202601 --dir "$job" > "$job/unidock.log" 2>&1

  find "$job" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.pdbqt' | wc -l
  tail -25 "$job/unidock.log"

```

blocks.en:
`fast`, `balance`, and `detail` control Uni-Dock's search effort. For follow-up docking, change the seed or search effort and use a new output directory. Verify that files contain poses and scores. Reconcile outputs against manifest IDs, inspect logs for CUDA or parsing errors, and record incomplete jobs. [Uni-Dock modes and batch manifest](https://github.com/dptech-corp/Uni-Dock/blob/main/unidock/README.md)

The upstream 1.2.0 release accommodates its default 30 × 30 × 30 Å box at 0.375 Å spacing. A box that exceeds the grid buffer is rejected by this release. For a broad search, record the bounds of each overlapping sub-box and use the CPU route if the full box is needed. Splitting the ligand manifest reduces batch size and leaves the per-box grid unchanged. [Uni-Dock 1.2.0 change log](https://github.com/dptech-corp/Uni-Dock/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#120---2026-06-11)
blocks.zh:
`fast`、`balance`、`detail` 调整 Uni-Dock 的搜索力度。复筛可换种子或提高搜索力度，并使用新的输出目录。每个文件需有有效姿态和评分记录。按候选 ID 对照清单与输出，查日志中的 CUDA 或解析错误，单独记录未完成项。 [Uni-Dock modes and batch manifest](https://github.com/dptech-corp/Uni-Dock/blob/main/unidock/README.md)

上游 1.2.0 支持默认 30 × 30 × 30 Å 的搜索盒，网格间距为 0.375 Å。超出网格缓冲区的盒会被拒绝。宽范围搜索可记录每个相互重叠的子盒边界，确需使用完整大盒时选 CPU 路线。拆分配体清单只减少批次大小，各盒网格维持原设置。[Uni-Dock 1.2.0 更新记录](https://github.com/dptech-corp/Uni-Dock/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#120---2026-06-11)

blocks.en: ### C. Optional GPU route · AutoDock-Vina-GPU 2.1 (OpenCL) Follow the upstream build instructions for the AutoDock-Vina-GPU 2.1 variant and record its source commit. In Linux Bash, set `VINA_GPU_METHOD_DIR` to the built method directory. Use `clinfo -l`, if installed, to identify the expected GPU under an OpenCL platform. For a build using precompiled kernels, make sure the device-specific kernel files are in the directory given by `opencl_binary_path`. Follow the upstream Windows build instructions for a native Windows installation.[9](REFERENCES.md#ref-9) [Vina-GPU 2.1 upstream](https://github.com/DeltaGroupNJUPT/Vina-GPU-2.1) Run this example from the project root after step 03. It stages one reviewed ligand in a dedicated input directory. Each output directory is new. The six search-box values come from `dock/box.txt`. The option `thread` is the number of GPU search lanes. The command writes `vinagpu.txt`, `vinagpu.log`, and the pose in `poses/`. Budget runtime from a sample run on the target GPU.
blocks.zh: ### C. 可选 GPU 路线 · AutoDock-Vina-GPU 2.1（OpenCL） 按上游说明编译 AutoDock-Vina-GPU 2.1 变体，记录源码提交。Linux Bash 中将 `VINA_GPU_METHOD_DIR` 设为构建完成后的方法目录。若装有 `clinfo`，用 `clinfo -l` 核对 OpenCL 平台是否识别预期的 GPU。使用预编译内核时，确认设备对应的内核文件在 `opencl_binary_path` 所指目录中。原生 Windows 安装按上游 Windows 构建说明操作。[9](REFERENCES.zh-CN.md#ref-9) [Vina-GPU 2.1 上游仓库](https://github.com/DeltaGroupNJUPT/Vina-GPU-2.1) 完成步骤 03 后，在项目根目录使用此示例。其中一个经过核验的配体放入独立输入目录，每次运行新建目录。搜索盒的六个字段取自 `dock/box.txt`。`thread` 设置 GPU 并行搜索通道数。输出包括 `vinagpu.txt`、`vinagpu.log` 和 `poses/` 中的位姿。耗时以目标 GPU 的样本实测估算。

blocks.shared:
```bash
(
  set -euo pipefail
  method=$(cd -- "${VINA_GPU_METHOD_DIR:?Set the built Vina-GPU method directory}" && pwd)
  test -x "$method/AutoDock-Vina-GPU-2-1"
  test -s dock/receptor.pdbqt
  test -s dock/box.txt
  test -s ligands/pdbqt/state001.pdbqt
  job="$PWD/dock/vinagpu_single_202601"
  mkdir "$job"
  mkdir "$job/ligands"
  cp ligands/pdbqt/state001.pdbqt "$job/ligands/"
  {
    printf '%s\n' "receptor = $PWD/dock/receptor.pdbqt" \
      "ligand_directory = $job/ligands" "output_directory = $job/poses" \
      "opencl_binary_path = $method" 'thread = 8000' 'seed = 202601'
    grep -E '^[[:space:]]*(center|size)_[xyz][[:space:]]*=' dock/box.txt
  } > "$job/vinagpu.txt"
  (
    cd "$method"
    ./AutoDock-Vina-GPU-2-1 --config "$job/vinagpu.txt"
  ) > "$job/vinagpu.log" 2>&1
  test -s "$job/poses/state001_out.pdbqt"
  grep -E '^MODEL|^REMARK VINA RESULT' "$job/poses/state001_out.pdbqt"
)
```

blocks.en: For a batch, stage only reviewed PDBQT files with unique basenames in the input directory and reconcile each expected output with the log. Record the device, engine variant, lane count and seed. Apply the chemical and coordinate checks in [step 05](#pose-handoff) before MD. This route has been checked against the upstream source and remains untested on a GPU in this repository. ### Benchmarking the docking engines Use identical receptor, search box, and ligand inputs. Document engine versions, scoring functions, search settings, seeds, device, thread count, elapsed wall time, successful ligand count, and peak VRAM where applicable. Report throughput as successful ligands per unit of wall time. Compare native-pose recovery, key contacts, ranking, and repeatability across seeds. Retain a separate score table for each engine.[8](REFERENCES.md#ref-8) Scripps AutoDock-GPU supports CUDA/OpenCL and follows the AutoDock4 workflow with affinity maps.[10](REFERENCES.md#ref-10) [Scripps AutoDock-GPU](https://github.com/forlilab/AutoDock-GPU) ### Follow-up docking and pose selection Redock shortlisted candidates with the same microstate, receptor frame, and focused search box. For the CPU example, repeat step 04A with seeds `202602` and `202603` and distinct logs and output directories. For Uni-Dock, set `--seed` for each repeat in `balance` mode, then assess increased sampling with `detail`. Group poses using a documented heavy-atom criterion and inspect pocket placement, steric clashes, and reference contacts. Record the selected pose and any failed runs. | Record | Fields | | --- | --- | | Inputs | Receptor chain, box config, ligand source, SDF record ID, net charge | | Docking | Engine, version, search effort, seed, output plus MODEL or SDF record, score | | Selection | Redocking reference, pose group, key contacts, rejection reasons, selected pose | ## 05. Docked-pose transfer to molecular dynamics - **Input** Selected docking model and original chemistry - **Outputs** validated SDF/MOL2 - **If a step fails** redock if the mapping is ambiguous Both workflows produce `lig_pose.sdf`. The source SDF defines the molecular graph, formal charge, protonation state, and stereochemistry. The selected docking pose supplies the heavy-atom coordinates in the original receptor frame. Choose the recovery method from the available metadata and source structure. Docking hardware is an independent choice. **Pose-transfer references.** See the Meeko paper for PDBQT interoperability and the Open Babel manual for subsequent format conversion.[1](REFERENCES.md#ref-1),[6](REFERENCES.md#ref-6) [Meeko paper](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jcim.5c02271) · [Open Babel CLI](https://openbabel.org/docs/Command-line_tools/babel.html) · [Open Babel paper](https://doi.org/10.1186/1758-2946-3-33) | Route | When to use it | How to recover | | --- | --- | --- | | **A · Meeko-preserved mapping** | New jobs, or outputs retaining Meeko's SMILES and atom indices. | Prepare and check the state, dock mapped PDBQT, export SDF with `mk_export.py`, then verify with RDKit. | | **[B · Legacy ADT with SDF template](#legacy-adt-handoff)** | A legacy ADT pose and the original SDF for the same chemical state are available. | Select the PDBQT MODEL, verify the atom map, then use RDKit to transfer coordinates, add hydrogens, check the pose and write SDF. | Archive the original ligand SDF and docking output in separate work directories for each force field, pose, and replicate. The example uses `ff_family=amber` and a pose from the CPU run. For existing data, set `protein_file`, `source_sdf`, and `pose_file` to the matching files. For Windows or GPU output, use the exact PDBQT path returned by step 04. Set `ff_family=charmm` for CHARMM. The staging block enters a new replicate directory only after the copies succeed. **Environment:** `docktools`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh: 用于批量对接时，输入目录只放经过核验且文件名不重复的 PDBQT 文件，逐一对照日志与预期输出。记录设备、引擎变体、通道数和种子。交接 MD 前按[步骤 05](#pose-handoff)核验化学结构和坐标。此路线已核对上游源码，尚未在本仓库用 GPU 实跑。 ### 对接引擎基准比较 用相同输入、口袋和配体清单，记录引擎版本、评分函数、搜索参数、种子、CPU 线程或 GPU 型号、实耗时、成功配体数和峰值显存。用成功配体数除以墙钟时间计算吞吐。分别检查已知配体的重对接所得 docking pose（对接位姿）、关键接触、候选排名和重复种子一致性。CPU 与 CUDA 引擎各自的搜索策略和参数定义有差异，原始分数保留在各自结果表中。[8](REFERENCES.zh-CN.md#ref-8) Scripps AutoDock-GPU 支持 CUDA/OpenCL，采用 AutoDock4 路线和相应的亲和力图。[10](REFERENCES.zh-CN.md#ref-10) [Scripps AutoDock-GPU](https://github.com/forlilab/AutoDock-GPU) ### 候选复筛与 docking pose（对接位姿）记录 用同一化学状态、receptor（受体）坐标和局部盒为候选重复对接。示例对 CPU 路线再用 `202602`、`202603` 重复步骤 04A 的单配体命令，替换 `--seed`、日志和目录。CUDA 路线可在 `balance` 下换种子检验稳定性，再用 `detail` 检查增加搜索力度后的结果。逐个 docking pose（对接位姿）看口袋位置、空间冲突和参考接触，按可解释的 heavy atom（重原子） docking pose（对接位姿）相似性分组；记录分组依据及进入 MD 的具体 docking pose（对接位姿）。保留以下字段，另列失败项。 | 记录 | 字段 | | --- | --- | | 输入 | receptor（受体）链、盒配置、配体来源、SDF 记录 ID、净电荷 | | 对接 | 引擎、版本、搜索力度、种子、输出文件和 MODEL 或 SDF 记录号、分数 | | 筛选 | 重对接参考、构象分组、关键接触、被淘汰原因、入选 docking pose（对接位姿） | ## 05. docking pose（对接位姿）的两条 MD 交接路线 - **输入** 所选 docking pose（对接位姿）及原始化学图 - **输出** 输出已核查 SDF/MOL2 - **失败时的操作** 映射不明时重对接 两条路线都交付 `lig_pose.sdf`。原始结构提供 bond order（键级）、formal charge（形式电荷）、protonation state（质子化状态）和手性，所选 docking pose（对接位姿）提供原位 heavy atom（重原子）坐标。根据手头的结构文件选择恢复工具，再按需要选择对接设备。 **交接依据** Meeko 的软件论文说明 PDBQT 与分子图的互操作，Open Babel 文档提供后续格式转换命令。[1](REFERENCES.zh-CN.md#ref-1),[6](REFERENCES.zh-CN.md#ref-6) [Meeko paper](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jcim.5c02271) · [Open Babel CLI](https://openbabel.org/docs/Command-line_tools/babel.html) · [Open Babel paper](https://doi.org/10.1186/1758-2946-3-33) | 路线 | 何时使用 | 如何恢复 | | --- | --- | --- | | **A · Meeko 保留映射 | 新项目，或结果仍含 Meeko 写入的 SMILES 与索引。 | Molscrub/RDKit → Meeko PDBQT → 对接 → `mk_export.py` 导出 SDF → RDKit 核对。 | | **[B · 旧 ADT + SDF 模板](#legacy-adt-handoff)** | 已有旧 ADT docking pose（对接位姿），并保存了同一化学状态的原始 SDF。 | 选定 PDBQT MODEL → 核对一一映射 → RDKit 回填 heavy atom（重原子）坐标、补氢及核对 → SDF。 | 保留原始 SDF 和所选运行的输出。每套 force field（力场）、姿态和独立重复各用一个目录。以下示例选 AMBER + CPU docking pose（对接位姿）。如选择 CHARMM，把 `ff_family=amber` 改为 `ff_family=charmm`。使用 GPU docking pose（对接位姿）时，从步骤 04B 或 04C 的输出目录查找该配体的 PDBQT，把 `pose_file` 改成查到的实际路径。 **环境：** `docktools`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。 已有数据时，将 `protein_file`、`source_sdf` 和 `pose_file` 设为相互匹配的文件。Windows 或 GPU 输出使用步骤 04 实际列出的 PDBQT 路径。复制成功后才进入新重复目录。

blocks.shared:
```bash
conda activate docktools
ff_family=amber
protein_file=input/protein.pdb
source_sdf=ligands/state001.sdf
pose_file=dock/cpu_single_202601/state001_out.pdbqt
run_dir="md/${ff_family}_state001_pose01_rep01"

test -s "$protein_file" && test -s "$source_sdf" && test -s "$pose_file" &&
  mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$run_dir")" && mkdir -- "$run_dir" &&
  cp -- "$protein_file" "$run_dir/protein.pdb" &&
  cp -- "$source_sdf" "$run_dir/state_original.sdf" &&
  cp -- "$pose_file" "$run_dir/selected_run.pdbqt" &&
  cd -- "$run_dir"
```

blocks.en:
### A. Pose recovery from Meeko metadata

Archive the original SDF and Meeko-prepared ligand PDBQT. In the docking output, verify `REMARK SMILES` and `REMARK SMILES IDX`, and check `REMARK H PARENT` where present. [Meeko export documentation](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/export_usage.html)

**Environment:** `Bash`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
### A. 保留 Meeko 映射

对接前归档原始 SDF 及 Meeko 制备的配体 PDBQT。对接后检查输出的 `REMARK SMILES`、`REMARK SMILES IDX`，并核对 `REMARK H PARENT` 记录（如有）。 [Meeko export documentation](https://meeko.readthedocs.io/en/develop/export_usage.html)

**环境：** `Bash`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
awk '/^REMARK SMILES / && $3 != "IDX" {print; found=1; exit}
     END {if (!found) exit 1}' selected_run.pdbqt
grep -m 1 '^REMARK SMILES IDX ' selected_run.pdbqt
grep -m 1 '^REMARK H PARENT ' selected_run.pdbqt || true
```

blocks.en:
Export once the mapping checks pass. For legacy ADT output without Meeko metadata, follow route B. For any new docking run, record its engine, search settings, and pose-selection rationale separately.

**Environment:** `docktools`. **Expected files or evidence:** `docked_poses.sdf`. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
映射检查通过后导出。对接输出没有这些记录时，旧 ADT 结果按路线 B 处理。若需要重新对接，为新 docking pose（对接位姿）单独记录引擎、参数和筛选依据。

**环境：** `docktools`。**预期文件或核查依据：** `docked_poses.sdf`。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
mk_export.py selected_run.pdbqt -s docked_poses.sdf
grep -E '^MODEL|^REMARK VINA RESULT' selected_run.pdbqt
obabel docked_poses.sdf -ocan
```

blocks.en:
**Optional native SDF from Uni-Dock.** If a Uni-Dock PDBQT output lacks Meeko metadata, use Uni-Dock Tools to prepare GPU input from the original SDF and redock against the same receptor and box to produce SDF poses with a molecular graph. This optional fallback produces poses from a new docking job. Start from the step 05 replicate directory. The first command returns to the project root. Keep the `run_dir` variable set above. [Uni-Dock Tools instructions](https://github.com/dptech-corp/Uni-Dock/blob/main/unidock_tools/README.md)

**Environment:** `dockgpu`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
**Uni-Dock 备选交接** 如果某个 Uni-Dock PDBQT 文件缺少 Meeko 化学映射，可用 Uni-Dock Tools 从原 SDF 准备 GPU 输入，然后以同一个 receptor（受体）和盒重新对接，取得有化学图的 SDF。这是补充路径，取得的是一次新对接的 docking pose（对接位姿）。在步骤 05 的重复目录中开始，下面第一条命令会返回项目根目录。保留上面的 `run_dir` 变量。 [Uni-Dock Tools instructions](https://github.com/dptech-corp/Uni-Dock/blob/main/unidock_tools/README.md)

**环境：** `dockgpu`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
cd ../..
conda install -n dockgpu --override-channels -c conda-forge python=3.11 pip
conda activate dockgpu
python -m pip install 'git+https://github.com/dptech-corp/Uni-Dock.git@1.2.0#subdirectory=unidock_tools'
mkdir -p dock/gpu_sdfprep_202601 dock/gpu_sdf_202601
unidocktools ligandprep -l ligands/state001.sdf -sd dock/gpu_sdfprep_202601
find dock/gpu_sdfprep_202601 -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.sdf' -print
```

blocks.en:
Check that the prepared ligand has the intended microstate. Before copying the results, verify that there is one SDF file for this ligand. A single file may contain multiple pose records.

**Environment:** `dockgpu`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
确认输出是所选的单一化学状态，再运行下面命令。检查输出只有一个配体的 SDF 文件（其内可以有多个 docking pose（对接位姿）），再复制到当前重复目录。

**环境：** `dockgpu`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

```bash
unidock --receptor dock/receptor.pdbqt --gpu_batch dock/gpu_sdfprep_202601/*.sdf  --config dock/box.txt --scoring vina --search_mode balance --keep_nonpolar_H  --num_modes 20 --seed 202601 --dir dock/gpu_sdf_202601  > dock/gpu_sdf_202601/unidock.log 2>&1
find dock/gpu_sdf_202601 -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*_out.sdf' -print
```

Before extracting a pose, verify its provenance and score. If it came from a PDBQT export, confirm the correspondence between its SDF record and PDBQT `MODEL`. The example selects record 1.

**Environment:** `docktools`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
核对 SDF 记录、docking pose（对接位姿）来源和评分后再提取。使用 PDBQT 转出的 SDF 时，核对 SDF 记录与 PDBQT MODEL 的对应关系。下面以第 1 条为示例。

**环境：** `docktools`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.en: ### B. Template-based recovery of legacy ADT poses Save the original SDF for the same microstate as `state_original.sdf` and the legacy Vina output as `selected_run.pdbqt`. Establish a one-to-one atom map from the preparation records, original ADT input, and atom identities. Verify heavy-atom elements, connectivity, and identifiers together. If the original chemical template, atom mapping, or stereochemistry remains uncertain, prepare a new input and redock with route A. This example uses MODEL 1. Change it to the verified model. The columns are PDBQT serial, coordinates (Å), and AutoDock atom type. For an AutoDock4 `.dlg`, extract the selected pose first. If a single pose has no MODEL record, confirm its contents and extract that structure explicitly. **Environment:** `Bash`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh: ### B. 原始 SDF 模板恢复旧 ADT docking pose（对接位姿） 把同一化学状态的原始 SDF 保存为 `state_original.sdf`，把旧 Vina 输出保存为 `selected_run.pdbqt`，放在本步骤的独立目录。利用原始 ADT 输入、原子名和制备记录核对一一映射，逐项确认 heavy atom（重原子）元素、连接和序号。仅凭元素相同或行顺序相同无法确认对应关系。模板、映射或手性无法确认时，回到 A 重新准备并对接。 下面以 MODEL 1 为例，按实际选择更改。输出各列是 PDBQT serial、三维坐标（Å）和 AutoDock 类型。如果输入是 AutoDock4 `.dlg`，先在对应工具中提取所选 docking pose（对接位姿）。如果单一 docking pose（对接位姿）没有 MODEL 标记，先确认文件只含所选 docking pose（对接位姿），再单独提取。 **环境：** `Bash`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.en:
Save the verified mapping as `atom_map.tsv` with two columns and no header. Column 1 is the **one-based** heavy-atom index after RDKit removes ordinary hydrogens from the source SDF. Column 2 is the atom serial in the selected PDBQT MODEL. Use these commands to inspect the template indices and elements.

**Environment:** `docktools`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
将经核对的映射保存为 `atom_map.tsv`，每行两列，无表头。第一列是 RDKit 读入原始 SDF 并去普通氢后的 heavy atom（重原子）编号，**从 1 起**。第二列是该原子在所选 PDBQT MODEL 的 serial。用下列命令查看模板编号和元素。

**环境：** `docktools`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
conda activate docktools
python - <<'RDKIT'
from rdkit import Chem

template, = Chem.SDMolSupplier("state_original.sdf", removeHs=True)
for atom in template.GetAtoms():
    print(atom.GetIdx() + 1, atom.GetSymbol())
RDKIT
```

blocks.en:
Run the following commands after reviewing the atom map. For the organic ligands covered here, RDKit retains the template's molecular graph, inserts the docked heavy-atom coordinates, and adds hydrogens. Resolve any disagreement between the template and stereochemistry assigned from the recovered 3D coordinates before continuing. [RDKit stereochemistry API](https://www.rdkit.org/docs/source/rdkit.Chem.rdmolops.html#rdkit.Chem.rdmolops.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D)

**Environment:** `docking-gromacs`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
映射审核后运行。本例适用于常规有机小分子。RDKit 从模板复制化学图，回填对接 heavy atom（重原子）坐标后补氢。从三维构象重新感知的 stereochemistry（立体化学）要与模板一致。遇到断言报错时暂停并复核。 [RDKit stereochemistry API](https://www.rdkit.org/docs/source/rdkit.Chem.rdmolops.html#rdkit.Chem.rdmolops.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D)

**环境：** `docking-gromacs`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
python - <<'RDKIT'
from math import dist
from pathlib import Path
from rdkit import Chem

template, = Chem.SDMolSupplier("state_original.sdf", removeHs=True)
assert template is not None and all(a.GetAtomicNum() > 1 for a in template.GetAtoms())
mapped_rows = [line.split() for line in Path("atom_map.tsv").read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
pose_rows = [line.split() for line in Path("pose_heavy.tsv").read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
mapping = {int(idx) - 1: int(serial) for idx, serial in mapped_rows}
coords = {int(serial): (float(x), float(y), float(z)) for serial, x, y, z, _ in pose_rows}
assert len(mapped_rows) == len(mapping) == template.GetNumAtoms()
assert len(pose_rows) == len(coords) == len(mapping)
assert set(mapping) == set(range(template.GetNumAtoms()))
assert len(set(mapping.values())) == len(mapping) and set(mapping.values()) == set(coords)

pose = Chem.Mol(template)
conf = pose.GetConformer()
assert conf.Is3D()
for idx, serial in mapping.items():
    conf.SetAtomPosition(idx, coords[serial])

pose = Chem.AddHs(pose, addCoords=True)
perceived = Chem.Mol(pose)
Chem.AssignStereochemistryFrom3D(perceived, replaceExistingTags=True)
assert Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(perceived)) == Chem.MolToSmiles(template)
assert Chem.GetFormalCharge(pose) == Chem.GetFormalCharge(template)

with Chem.SDWriter("lig_pose.sdf") as writer:
    writer.write(pose)
saved, = Chem.SDMolSupplier("lig_pose.sdf", removeHs=False)
saved_conf = saved.GetConformer()
errors = []
for idx, serial in mapping.items():
    p = saved_conf.GetAtomPosition(idx)
    errors.append(dist((p.x, p.y, p.z), coords[serial]))
assert max(errors) <= 0.02, max(errors)
print(f"Maximum mapped heavy-atom position difference: {max(errors):.4f} Å")
RDKIT
```

blocks.en:
`0.02 Å` is the file-transfer tolerance used here. Archive the source SDF, ADT input, model number, and atom map. Use `lig_pose.sdf` after the checks pass.

### Pose and chemical-identity validation

In `docktools`, load the source and recovered SDF records in Python. Compare their canonical isomeric SMILES and formal charges. RDKit removes ordinary explicit hydrogens in memory for this comparison. The SDF used for parameterization retains explicit hydrogens and in-place coordinates. Resolve parsing or identity discrepancies before proceeding.

**Environment:** `docking-gromacs`. **Expected files or evidence:** terminal output or the paths named below. For planning, use the per-stage budget in the quickstart.
blocks.zh:
`0.02 Å` 是这里校验文件写出与原位坐标的工程容差。归档原始 SDF、ADT 输入、MODEL 号和映射表，校验通过后再用 `lig_pose.sdf`。

### docking pose（对接位姿）与化学结构验收

在已激活的 `docktools` 环境进入 Python，对照原始化学状态和恢复 docking pose（对接位姿）。两条输出分别检查规范异构 SMILES 和净电荷。为比较化学图，RDKit 在内存中移除普通显式氢；用于参数化的原 SDF 文件保持显式氢与原位坐标。结果不同或分子读入失败时，先查明原因。

**环境：** `docking-gromacs`。**预期文件或核查依据：** 终端输出或下方命令指定的文件。耗时和磁盘规划见快速入门的分阶段表。

blocks.shared:
```bash
python
```

```python
from rdkit import Chem

source = Chem.SDMolSupplier("state_original.sdf")[0]
pose = Chem.SDMolSupplier("lig_pose.sdf")[0]
Chem.MolToSmiles(source, isomericSmiles=True) == Chem.MolToSmiles(pose, isomericSmiles=True)
Chem.GetFormalCharge(source) == Chem.GetFormalCharge(pose)
exit()
```

blocks.en:
**Check.** Check the recovered molecular graph, bond orders, stereochemistry, and integer net charge against the source SDF. Compare mapped heavy-atom coordinates in the original receptor frame for the selected `MODEL`. Regenerate candidates with route A if the pose or chemical identity cannot be established. Proceed to ligand parameterization in step 06 once these checks pass. [Meeko export in the Vina tutorial](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docking_basic.html#exporting-results-to-sdf)

## Choose a pose handoff and a search profile

| Observation | Route | Acceptance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Selected PDBQT model has complete Meeko SMILES and atom-index metadata | A: mapped Meeko SDF export | Verify graph, stereochemistry, formal charge and fixed-frame coordinates |
| Meeko metadata absent or inconsistent | B: original SDF plus a unique reviewed atom map | Verify the same four properties and preserve the mapping table |
| Mapping ambiguous or chemistry fails review | Reprepare and redock from the original microstate | Apply route A to the newly generated pose |

Use Uni-Dock `fast` for broad triage, `balance` for follow-up ranking, and `detail` for a small reviewed set, where the installed 1.2.0 binary supports those modes. Record the installed help output, seed and search mode and calibrate against a known pose before screening. Use [batch manifest and restart parameters](../examples/README.md) and the [box template](../config/box.template.txt) for persistent per-job files. A blind box should cover the intended receptor region and be reviewed in PyMOL; define all dimensions in Å.
blocks.zh:
**验收** 用原始 SDF 与输出核对分子图、bond order（键级）、手性和整数净电荷。逐原子核对入选 MODEL 与 SDF 的 heavy atom（重原子）坐标。叠加时保留绝对坐标。原始 docking pose（对接位姿）或化学身份无法确认时，回到路线 A 重新生成候选。通过后进入第 06 节参数化。 [Meeko export in the Vina tutorial](https://autodock-vina.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docking_basic.html#exporting-results-to-sdf)

[返回目录](../README.zh-CN.md#contents)

## 选择位姿交接与搜索配置

| 观察 | 路线 | 验收 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 所选 PDBQT 模型含完整 Meeko SMILES 和原子索引元数据 | A：用 Meeko 映射导出 SDF | 核对化学图、立体化学、形式电荷和固定参考系坐标 |
| Meeko 元数据缺失或不一致 | B：原始 SDF 加经过核查的唯一原子映射 | 核对同样四项并保存映射表 |
| 映射不明确或化学核查失败 | 从原始微观状态重新制备并重对接 | 对新生成的 docking pose（对接位姿）执行 A |

若安装的 Uni-Dock 1.2.0 支持，初筛用 `fast`，复筛用 `balance`，少量经审阅的候选用 `detail`。记录本机帮助、随机种子与搜索模式，筛选前用已知 docking pose（对接位姿）校准。用[批次清单与续跑参数](../examples/README.md)和[对接盒模板](../config/box.template.txt)保存每个作业的文件。盲对接盒应覆盖计划搜索的 receptor（受体）区域，在 PyMOL 中核查，尺寸单位统一为 Å。
